\node[card] (n0) {\heading{1}{固定テスト円板に対する上界}{A bound for each fixed test disc}$h=k,\ q=R_k,\quad P_{R_k}(g)\le C$\quad\Tx{すべての有限面積円板$g$}{for every finite-area disc $g$}};
\node[card,below=3.4cm of n0] (n1) {\heading{2}{行列式束上のpsh包絡}{A psh envelope on the determinant bundle}$Y=(\det T^{1,0}X)\setminus0_X,\quad \ell=\log|s|_k^2$\\[3pt]$\ell-C\le v\le\ell,\qquad v(\lambda s)=v(s)+\log|\lambda|^2$};
\node[card,below=3.4cm of n1] (n2) {\heading{3}{双対束の曲率を読む}{Read the curvature of the dual bundle}$v-\ell=u\circ\pi,\quad -C\le u\le0$\\[3pt]$|s_i^*|^2=e^{-(a_i+u)},\quad -R_k+i\partial\bar\partial u\ge0$};
\node[result,below=3.4cm of n2] (n3) {\heading{4}{有界ポテンシャルを平滑化}{Smooth the bounded potential}$\forall\varepsilon>0\quad\exists u_\varepsilon\in C^\infty(X,\mathbb R):\quad -R_k+i\partial\bar\partial u_\varepsilon\ge-\varepsilon k$};
